notes:
- fix(ui): a two-finger swipe on macOS goes back or forward once per flick instead of twice
- feat(ui): a swipe shows an edge arrow that fills in as you pull and turns blue when releasing will navigate
- fix(ui): a swipe over a horizontal carousel scrolls it instead of leaving the page
- fix(security): the two-finger swipe is refused when the address bar is locked, like the Back button and Alt+Left
- feat(ui): every message box is one dark design, on both platforms, with buttons that name the action
- fix(ui): dialogs open centred on the window instead of in the screen corner
- fix(ui): the kiosk window no longer draws a pale hairline around the screen edge
- fix(ui): text is a point larger on macOS, matching the system size
- fix(ui): text on Windows uses the system typeface instead of Arial
- fix(session): reopening the tabs you left keeps the exact settings or history section you were on
- fix(ui): reloading Settings or History, and going back to them, works instead of leaving a blank page
- fix(crash): a crash now reports the faulting module, its load address and a stack, so a report can be read without the machine that produced it
- fix(crash): a macOS crash uploads the full system crash report with the event
- fix(crash): a renderer that dies now sends the log leading up to it
- fix(stability): the macOS kiosk no longer risks quitting the browser when it pins the window
- fix(security): dismissing a certificate, external-app or file-access warning now takes the safe choice instead of allowing it
- fix(ui): the second-screen block can no longer be dragged off the screen and left unreachable
- fix(ui): the swipe arrow no longer stays on screen when you switch tabs mid-swipe
